method.quote: Payer shall pay one case rate per visit for the codes listed in Exhibit A, whatever the units billed.

flags.quote: Section 2.3. Adjustments: the multiple procedure payment reduction applies; the assistant reduction applies; sequestration does not apply; NCCI edits do not apply; timed units are counted under the Medicare pooled 8-minute rule.

rounding.quote: Section 2.2. All payment amounts are truncated to the whole cent.

effective_from.quote: This Agreement is effective 2026-04-01 and continues until either party ends it on 90 days written notice.
